subject: SIG starter — prefilling approach, evidence cadence & clarifying asks
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@blueoak.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: SIG starter — prefilling approach, evidence cadence & clarifying asks

Hi Ana —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we can get the SIG started without back-and-forth: 

- Proposal: We can prefill the standard SIG spreadsheet with answers for service ownership, control descriptions, and links to centralized evidence. That reduces the items we need your team to provide to ~10 ownership confirmations + any customer-specific carve-outs. I attached a working prefill (redwood_sig_prefill_v1.xlsx).
- SOC 2 status: We completed SOC 2 Type II (security) in 2025; I attached a 1-page summary of the report and a redacted evidence index.
- Residency / HIPAA: We understand you asked about HIPAA scope during the call — Redwood supports HIPAA-covered workflows via our Private/private-cloud offerings; we keep a signed BAA and specific hosting configs. 

Clarifying asks from BlueOak that will speed the process: 
1) Can you confirm whether BlueOak requires data residency in AWS us-east-1 for the initial pilot? If yes, we'll mark hosting in the prefill.
2) Which SIG sections are highest priority for your legal team (privacy, encryption, vendor ops, etc.) so we can surface evidence early?
3) Do you accept redacted SOC artifacts (yes/no)? If legal needs full unredacted material, we will route a secure share with an NDA.

Next steps I suggest: 
- I send the prefilled SIG by EOD today.
- You or legal send any must-have fields / non-starters.
- Technical follow-up: Karthik can run through our network diagram and encryption flow if you want a short tech call.

If that sounds good, we'll queue the prefill. Proposed window for a 30-min tech sync: Thu 12/3 09:00–11:00 PT or 14:00–16:00 PT. I can send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

Thanks —

Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: redwood_sig_prefill_v1.xlsx
From: Ana Gomez <ana.gomez@blueoak.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@blueoak.com
Date: 2026-12-01T17:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG starter — prefilling approach, evidence cadence & clarifying asks

Priyom —

Appreciate the recap and the prefill offer. A few quick clarifying questions from our side before we accept a prefilling approach: 

1) Residency: For the pilot, we prefer us-east-1 but could be flexible if you can guarantee data at rest residency and provide the specific region tag in your config. Will the prefill indicate the exact region used?
2) SOC artifacts: Legal is generally fine with redacted reports, but they require an index mapping each SIG control to the corresponding SOC evidence item (so we can track gaps). Can you produce that mapping?
3) Encryption: We need confirmation of customer data encryption at rest and key management ownership. If keys are customer-managed (KMS/HSM), please note that as an option in the prefill.
4) Third-party sub-processors: Please include the current list of infra sub-processors and whether any have access to plaintext data.

One more ask: do you have a sanitized network diagram and a short (1–2 page) dataflow that shows PII/PHI paths? If so, include those as attachments; if not, we can accept the SOC index + Karthik's walkthrough.

Assignee from our side: I'm copying legal to answer residency/NDAs. They may request an NDA for full artifacts.

Proposed next call: Thu 12/3 10:00 PT would work for a 30-min tech sync (we prefer 10:00). If your team can do 10:00, please send the invite.

Thanks,
Ana
Ana Gomez
Head of Security Operations | BlueOak Analytics
ana.gomez@blueoak.com | +1 617-555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG starter — prefilling approach, evidence cadence & clarifying asks

Thanks Ana — quick technical responses inline: 

1) Residency: We can pin services to us-east-1 for the pilot. The prefill will list the actual region tag and the account IDs used for the customer tenancy.

2) SOC mapping: We will provide a control-to-evidence mapping CSV (one row per SIG control + SOC2 evidence id). That will be generated from our evidence tracker and included with the prefill.

3) Encryption & keys: All customer data at rest is AES-256. For hosted (Redwood-managed) deployments keys are managed by Redwood KMS; for Dedicated/Private customers we support customer-managed KMS keys (BYOK) — we'll indicate both options in the prefill and mark which flows support BYOK.

4) Sub-processors: I'll attach our current infra sub-processor list and a sanitized network diagram that shows where plaintext may be processed. Note: the only infra provider with potential access is our managed logging pipeline (log-processor.company.com) — logs are redacted for payloads; we can mark that explicitly.

I've attached a short SOC2 summary and a high-level network diagram for your review. Karthik

Attachments: SOC2-summary-Redwood-2025.pdf, network-diagram.png

Thanks Karthik / Priyom — that answers most of our immediate questions.

We can proceed with the prefill + control-to-evidence mapping. Legal will confirm whether an NDA is required for unredacted items; I'll loop back if they do. 

Confirmed: Thu 12/3 10:00 PT for the 30-min tech sync works for our team. Please send the invite and include the calendar link above. For the agenda: 1) residency confirmation + region tag, 2) BYOK options and practical steps, 3) quick walk of the network diagram / logging pipeline.

If possible, please also add a short owners table in the prefill (who to contact for each control) — that will speed up evidence collection.

See you on Thursday.

Regards,
Ana
